$comment: Booking rules. Read by the availability/booking functions. Windows are arrival windows, in business-local time.

crm.$comment: Where online bookings go. apiBase set: the booking flow, manage page and quotes talk to Haul-off Ops (the CRM) at this address, and jobs land on its schedule. null: the site's own engine and Google Calendar (netlify/functions/*). Scheduling rules (windows, days, notice, prices) then live in the CRM: Settings -> Online booking.

durationMinutes.$comment: On-site time per load size, excluding the arrival window.

cancellationPolicy: Please give us 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule when you can — but we understand plans change.
